votes.motion: An implied motion to approve Resolution 2025-24, as currently constituted, has been                    made by council rule. Mayor Kaufusi recommended the reappointment of Mario Markides to the Airport Board for a one-year term, ending June 30, 2026, and submitted the recommendation for the Council’s advice and consent.

An implied motion to approve Ordinance 2025-34, as currently constituted, has been                    made by council rule. Aaron Ardmore, Planning Supervisor, presented a proposal discussed earlier in the study meeting regarding a property near the airport.

An implied motion to approve Ordinance 2025-35, as currently constituted, has been                    made by council rule. Nancy Robison, Planner, presented a request to rezone the property from R1-8 to R1-6 to allow for 19 additional single-family building lots at roughly the same elevation as Canyon Road.
